'''[[File:Emergence.jpg|thumb|300px]]Emergence''' is a Spotlight Mission featuring [[Cyclonus]] and [[Megatronus]] that ran from September 6th to October 4th.

== Changes/Rewards ==
Medium and Hard Map energy consumption per node has now been reduced from 2 and 3 to 1 and 2 respectively.

== Chapter 1 - A Brewing Storm ==

=== Friends? ===
Part 1
*[[Starscream]]: ''Oh, by the curse of the Primus, say it's not true. You're here now?''
*[[Cyclonus]]: ''You have optics, don't you? Of course I'm here. But the question is...where is hers?''
*Starscream: ''So, you're fresh out the Spacebridge? Perfect!''
*Cyclonus: ''Look, I don't know where I am or why I'm here...and frankly, how you're here. Last I saw of you, you were reduced to a pile of ash and a meaningless crown.''
*Starscream: ''That's not how I remember historic occurrences...but misaligned pasts don't mean anything here. I suggest...friend, we work together to assure our survival.''
*Cyclonus: ''I serve but one...Galvatron!''
*Starscream: ''Galvatron?! Why...err...there's no one here on New Quintessa by that name. But...there are a couple of Megatrons, multiple Optimus types, and a mess of Autogoons. I suggest you consider an alliance. Perhaps we can find this Galvatron you speak of?''
*Cyclonus: ''I'll consider it.''
Part 2
*Starscream: ''So, how have your deliberations gone? You ready to join me in a quest for survival...and conquest?''
*Cyclonus: ''I have seen the carnage that possesses this planet. And I do suspect that those here may treat me with hostility.''
*Starscream: ''Precisely why you should join me.''
*Cyclonus: ''But hwy join you when Decepticons of Megatron's stature could provide better prospects of success?''
*Starscream: ''Because knowledge is power...and I know something they don't.''
*Cyclonus: ''Which is?''
*Starscream: ''Megatronus is here...and I know where. He's the key to our survival.''
*Cyclonus: ''MEGATRONUS?! That changes things...''
Part 3
*Starscream: ''You've got to be kidding me. What are you doing here?''
*[[Ultra Magnus]]: ''We're here to ask you a few questions. It's about a new arrival...one I'd like to keep from connecting with Galvatron.''
*Starscream: ''Why, whatever do you mean? You know that now I'm simply a [https://tfwiki.net/wiki/NAIL Non-Aligned Indiginous Life-form.] I consort with no-one...''
*Ultra Magnus: ''...because no-one will consort with you? I suspect that would not stop you from pursuing an alliance with a new-comer ...like, say ...Cyclonus.''
*Starscream: ''I...err ...have no idea what you're talking about.''
*Ultra Magnus: ''Perhaps we can do something to jog your memory banks.''
=== Welcome to the Madness ===
Part 1
*Starscream: ''They know you're here.''
*Cyclonus: ''Who knows I'm here?''
*Starscream: ''The Autobots, Ultra Magnus, and the one they call The Commander.''
*Cyclonus: ''The Commander?''
*Starscream: ''Yes, a human vermin they somehow allowed to lead them.''
*Cyclonus: ''So, you told them of my presence?''
*Starscream: ''Of course not! Why would I betray an ally?''
*Cyclonus: ''Because it is what you do.''
*Starscream: ''I'm a changed bot. They have their intel, and I have mine. I suggest it would be prudent, though, to get our jets in gear and find Megatronus.''
Part 2
*Cyclonus: ''You lied to me!''
*Starscream: ''I swear, I didn't tell Ultra Magnus a thing.''
*[[Galvatron]]: ''He's not talking about that, he's talking about me!''
*Starscream: ''I...uh...ah...was just about to...''
*Galvatron: ''To leave? Or be vaporized, again? Be gone... I have business with Cyclonus.''
Part 3
*Galvatron: ''So, you've found your way to my side again.''
*Cyclonus: ''By chance...and good fortune. The traitor said there is one here of ultimate power.''
*Galvatron: ''You stand before him you fool.''
*Cyclonus: ''No, an ancient power, an original Prime...Megatronus.''
*Galvatron: ''Megatronus? I see you still serve a purpose. Keep serving it and you may share in the glory when I crush this so-called ancient power.''
Part 4
*Ultra Magnus: ''The rat was right, you are here. I assume your mater is not far behind.''
*Cyclonus: ''I concur that Starscream is indeed a rat. But, I can neither confirm nor deny your assumption.''
*Ultra Magnus: ''I'll confirm my own assumptions.''
*Cyclonus: ''I doubt that will be possible once I turn you into a pile of blowhard scrap.''
== Chapter 2 - Manic Derangement ==

=== The One That We Want ===
Part 1
*Marissa: ''So, it's true, Ultra Magnus?''
*Ultra Magnus: ''I'm afraid so. Cyclonus and Galvatron are back together again.''
*Optimus Prime: ''But I was made aware you and the Commander did battle with him. How did you fare?''
*Ultra Magnus: ''We're ok, but unfortunately...he escaped.''
*Optimus Prime: ''The Decepticons do display a skill for doing that.''
*Marissa: ''So what do we do?''
*Optimus Prime: ''Whatever we can to prevent the Megatrons...and now Galvatron...from finding and joining forces with Megatronus.''
Part 2
*Galvatron: ''Why must I always be surrounded by inferiors?''
*Cyclonus: ''Because you are superior?''
*Galvatron: ''Bah! Do not patronize me, Once again you confront the Autobots and once again you retreat in cowardice!''
*Cyclonus: ''Strategic disengagement so one may reevaluate the situation and function to fight another day is a sound tactic.''
*Galvatron: ''When will I find a bot that can just win and not make excuses?!''
*[[Tantrum]]: ''Today's your lucky day, because you just found me.''
*Galvatron: ''And why should I trust you to fare better than Cyclonus?''
*Tantrum: ''Because I'm bored and have a serious need to bang heads with Autobots.''
Part 3
*Tantrum: ''You're the best they could do? I was expecting someone a little more challening.''
*Ultra Magnus: ''And we were expecting Galvatron.''
*Tantrum: ''Sorry, the boss is busy. But I'm sure I can accommodate you...by crushing your diodes, mutilating your gears, and stomping out your sparks.''
*Ultra Magnus: ''That is not very accommodating, but let's get this over with. Galvatron is the one we want.''
=== Deserter ===
Part 1
*Tantrum: ''Who is firing on us?! The shots are getting closer.''
*Cyclonus: ''Who do you think? Galvatron. Obviously he's become unhinged again.''
*Tantrum: ''Has he ever been hinged?''
*Cyclonus: ''No, not really. Even the therapy session on Torkulon couldn't curb his penchant for lashing out.''
*Tantrum: ''Then why do you still serve him? He rewards your loyalty with abuse and laser blasts.''
*Cyclonus: ''You're right. I believe the time has come for me to seek a new alliance...a more powerful one.''
*Tantrum: ''Let me know how that works out for you. But me? I'm laying low for a while. This place is getting too volatile.''
Part 2
*Galvatron: ''So the failure presents himself.''
*Cyclonus: ''With all due respect...quit with the hostility, and especially the blasting.''
*Galvatron: ''THE INSOLENCE! HOW DARE YOU QUESTION ME?!''
*Cyclonus: ''Don't worry, my questions for you are done. I know the answer. It is time for me to move on.''
*Galvatron: ''WHAAAAAAT?! NEVER...EAT THIS!''
*Cyclonus: ''You missed me...you're slipping. Good luck, Galvatron...my master you will be no longer.''
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: ''It appears someone's minions have deserted them.''
*Ultra Magnus: ''They always do.''
*Galvatron: ''Desert in not the right word. Rendered useless is. Just as I soon render you.''
*Optimus Prime: ''When will you learn that loyalty demanded but not returned is the path to destruction?''
*Galvatron: ''When will you learn that me standing before you is your path to destruction?''
== Chapter 3 - Contact ==

=== New Allegiances ===
Part 1
*Cyclonus: ''I thought you were going to lay low.''
*Tantrum: ''This is about as low as a bull can go. How's your search for Mega-mega going?''
*Cyclonus: ''He's near, I know it. Others have been distracted by Galvatron's antics, but I remain focused on finding him...one of the original Primes.''
*Tantrum: ''What if he's worse than Galvatron?''
*Cyclonus: ''What if he's not? It's a chance I'm willing to take in this chaotic land I have been brought to.''
Part 2
*Cyclonus: ''Has my quest come to fruition? Does a god stand before me?''
*[[Megatronus]]: ''A god? That is a word for you to use, not I. Fruition? If your desire was to cease to function, perhaps.''
*Cyclonus: ''I come to you in subservience, for I know who and what you are.''
*Megatronus: ''As do others. I know they all seek me. How is it that you have found me first?''
*Cyclonus: ''It must be the will of the Primus.''
*Megatronus: ''You say you come in subservience? Then display your fealty. I need time to prepare. Give me that time and I shall consider your entreaty.''
*Cyclonus: ''Your word is my command.''
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: ''Ultra Magnus says despite your loyalty you can be made to understand reason. Understand this - your master has been defeated. Stand aside and avoid undue conlfict.''
*Cyclonus: ''My master? I believe you are mistaken, for a god cannot be defeated.''
*Optimus Prime: ''Galvatron is hardly a god...more a maniacally deranged sadistic Decepticon that cannot be trusted.''
*Cyclonus: ''I would never mistake Galvatron for a god, and he is no longer my master.''
*Optimus Prime: ''God? That means...you've found him?''
*Cyclonus: ''If it gives you solace, yes. But, to what does that help you once I extinguish your spark in the name of Lord Megatronus?''
=== Who's your Deity? ===
Part 1
*Marissa: ''His presence has been officially confirmed?''
*Optimus Prime: ''Second hand confirmation by Cyclonus...but yes. What we assumed has been confirmed.''
*Marissa: ''Course of action?''
*Optimus Prime: ''Nothing has changed. We must pursue this potential threat and see if reason can prevail.''
*Marissa: ''And if we don't reach him first?''
*Optimus Prime: ''Forces of immeasurable destruction may collide.''
Part 2
*Megatronus: ''You failed. Predictable. Your kind does not have the capacity to serve one such as I.''
*Cyclonus: ''It was not due to a lack of trying. The Commander has arrayed a formidable group of combatants.''
*Megatronus: ''The Commander? Do you speak of 13? Is he here?''
*Cyclonus: ''I don't know who 13 is, but The Commander is a human those Autobot wretches have put in charge of their forces. For what reason, I do not know.''
*Megatronus: ''A HUMAN?! The pestilent species from the planet called Earth? Surely you jest.''
*Cyclonus: ''Jesting is not my nature, but be warned. Those that come for you, and there are others, pose a serious threat.''
Megatronus: ''Ha. You say you do not make jokes, and yet you say such a thing. Someone poses a threat to me? I think not.''
Part 3
*Megatronus: ''13? Is that you?''
*Optimus Prime: ''I am Optimus Prime. I am not a number.''
*Megatronus: ''You cannot escape your past.''
*Optimus Prime: ''The past follows us, but the future leads us to what must be done.''
*Megatronus: ''Then tell me, what must be done?''
*Optimus Prime: ''Secure the peace, and return those of us trapped to our proper homes.''
*Megatronus: ''And if I say otherwise?''
*Optimus Prime: ''That would be something I wish to avoid.''
*Megatronus: ''Too late 13...I say otherwise. It is time to teach you your first lesson in what it means to be an original Prime.''
